purpose: Define Topics as composable semantic groupings so a higher-level mechanism may be described by composing existing Topics instead of duplicating their documentation or semantics.

topics.name: Topic Composition
topics.purpose: Define Topics as composable semantic groupings so a higher-level mechanism may be described by composing existing Topics instead of duplicating their documentation or semantics.

operations.name: Resolve composed Topic
outputs: component Topic graph and semantic surface

semantics.composition_rule: A Topic may be composed from any number of existing Topics.
semantics.reuse_rule: Composition references component Topics rather than copying their members/semantics.
semantics.order_example: An Order Topic may be created from existing Topics that collectively describe order creation and its effects across the full chain.
semantics.runtime_example: Runtime may compose many Topics because its semantic surface spans multiple mechanisms.
semantics.identity_rule: Composed Topic has its own stable identity while retaining traceability to components.
semantics.documentation_rule: Composition allows a mechanism to be specified without redundant parallel documentation.

invariants.rule: Every machine-significant canonical node is classified by explicit Topic membership or explicitly marked outsider; Topics may inherit and compose other Topics.

hard_gates.condition: composed Topic copies component semantics instead of referencing them

cross-cutting mechanism forced into duplicated documentation
component Topic resolved by fuzzy/path heuristic
